targets.algorithm: fixture hash and deterministic semantic reducer execute in JavaScript
the exact fixture hash executes in fixed four-page linear Wasm; the shared deterministic semantic reducer and Canvas/DOM host adapter execute in JavaScript

equivalence: Both targets consume byte-identical generated fixtures and must match complete fixture, semantic, checkpoint, counter, and visual outputs exactly. Wasm residency and host work are disclosed rather than represented as an all-Wasm game.
floatingPointPolicy: No floating-point arithmetic is used by fixture generation, reducers, counters, digests, or the Wasm kernel. Canvas drawing is an untimed visual adapter outside the oracle.

rights.detail: All fixtures and visuals are generated by repository code; no external media, fonts, audio, or user data are read.

unavailable.reason: Validation records contain outputs and counters only; no durations are collected.
Audio-event counters are validated, but the runnable demo does not create an AudioContext or play sound.
